title: Pin uv version in real CI workflows (.github/workflows/*)
description: Review finding (z3jb round): docs/renode-workflow.md:462 now pins 'pip install "uv>=0.11,<0.12"' but the actual workflows still use bare unpinned 'pip install uv' — .github/workflows/renode.yml:46,189, interop.yml, fuzz.yml, renode-firmware.yml. Docs example is now stricter than the CI it illustrates. Apply the same bounded pin (or astral-sh/setup-uv with version input) to each workflow; verify each workflow's uv usage still parses (actionlint or YAML lint if available). Discovered from z3jb review passes.
